site.name: SchweizMobil
site.tagline: Entdecke die schönsten Wege der Schweiz
site.description: Switzerland's official national platform for non-motorized-traffic route planning and navigation — hiking, cycling, mountain biking, skating, canoeing, and winter sports. Publicly backed (Bund, Kantone, Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Schweiz Tourismus listed as sponsors in the footer).

signatureGesture.description: A red square containing a white Swiss-cross-derived star/flourish mark (visually related to the national cross but stylized, paired with the word "plus" in a casual script in one occurrence). Appears three times on the captured page: (1) small, in the header wordmark; (2) large, as the illustration for the "SchweizMobil Plus" card, overlaid on a topographic map; (3) again, smaller, as part of the "Aktuelles" card's flat-illustration icon.
signatureGesture.note: Present in 3 places but never extended into structural chrome (dividers, footer treatment, background watermark) — it's treated as decorative/illustrative, not systemic. See uplift-questions.md Variant C.

photography.description: Real, high-quality, specific Swiss landscape/outdoor photography — alpine streams, hikers on rocky trails, a lido with swan pedal-boats, cyclists at golden hour, a child eating outdoors. Not generic stock.
photography.note: Consistently cropped into small, uniformly-sized rectangular cards (roughly 4:3) across every content row — never given more than card-scale share of canvas outside the hero. See uplift-improvements.md #2 and uplift-questions.md Variant B.

systemComponents.description: Wanderland / Veloland / Mountainbikeland / Skatingland / Kanuland / Winter — color-coded per palette.activity-*, icon + label, overlaid on the hero's bottom edge on desktop, reflows to a 2-column grid on mobile.

Image + heading + body copy + "Mehr erfahren" link. Every single row uses the identical image-left/text-right composition on desktop (stacks image-top/text-bottom on mobile) — no compositional variation across the 5 occurrences: Routen mit Badespass, Die schönsten Wanderungen am Wasser, SchweizMobil Plus, App SchweizMobil, Aktuelles.
2×2 grid (1-column stack on mobile) of image tiles with a colored label bar overlay, no body copy: Familienwanderungen, Gravelbike-Touren, Genial legal, Hindernisfreie Wege.

A small red circular button fixed to the page's right edge, present across scroll positions — likely a persistent help/feedback/contact widget.

voice.heroHeadline: Entdecke die schönsten Wege der Schweiz
voice.register: civic-informational, second-person ("du"), warm but plain — not salesy, not playful. Consistent across every captured sample; no tonal contrast between sections.

samples.text: Fluss- und Seebäder bieten eine willkommene Abkühlung entlang von SchweizMobil-Routen. Entdecke unsere Auswahl.
Ob Bergseen, tosende Wasserfälle, plätschernde Bäche oder lauschige Badeplätze – diese Wanderwege verlaufen in unmittelbarer Nähe von Gewässern. Ideal für eine Abkühlung an heissen Tagen.

SchweizMobil Plus ist der perfekte Begleiter für alle, die gerne in der Natur unterwegs sind. Zusätzlich zu den bewährten Funktionen von SchweizMobil bietet dir SchweizMobil Plus eine Vielzahl nützlicher Tools für deine Tourenplanung.
Die kostenlose App SchweizMobil ist der perfekte Begleiter für alle, die gerne draussen unterwegs sind – egal ob im Sommer oder im Winter.
